BearWitnessTHP00.description: Order (Tessavain). At the start of EVERY round, each of your Covenant allies within your Attunement Range (White) gains Temp HP equal to your White rank (keeps-higher; Temp HP does not stack). 07-24u: replaced edhaOrderRoundTick and its three bespoke combat hooks per iron rule 2b. Two builds made it expressible -- `whenMoment: round-start` on the edha-combat-timing dispatcher (with the generic round-boundary latch and its mid-combat-reload guard), and `target: list-members`, which reads the H3 `covenants` ledger directly instead of re-deriving it from a name-keyed owner scan. The amount was edhaColorRank(owner, 'white') in engine code and is now the formula below, so it is editable in Foundry. A White rank of 0 grants nothing and posts no card, as before.

ConcordRider0000.description: Order (Tessavain). 2bV: the first-attack rider — a creature on YOUR covenants ledger deals damage to an enemy of yours while you are armed (`concord`): +your Presence, same type as the hit (blank damageType = match). oncePerRoundPerDealer = each ally's FIRST hit each round (Ben R8: the rider rides damage application, so a clean miss leaves it armed); the owner's own attacks are excluded by the require mode. Cost: 1 Investiture

The hands met. The promise was older than either of them.

Spend 1 Investiture and touch a willing ally; you and that ally enter a Covenant for the scene. While the Covenant holds, you and the ally each gain +1 to all defenses when within Attunement Range of each other, and may use the Aid action targeting each other at any range within Attunement Range. A Covenant ends if either party deliberately attacks the other. You may sustain up to your tier active Covenants.

CovenantPact0000.description: Order (Tessavain). The pact: the targeted ally joins your `covenants` ledger and bears the Covenant marker for the scene. 07-24u: replaced a preUseItem TAKEOVER (edhaOrderCovenant) per iron rule 2b, and every dial the takeover hard-coded is a field here. `multiOwner` because the covenant icon is SHARED between Order PCs -- without it one owner's fizzle strips another owner's icon. `sceneScoped: false` because the pact follows the ally, not the ground. requireDisposition + requireAdjacent enforce 'target the willing ALLY' and 'Covenant requires touch' BEFORE any cost is paid, so the takeover's 'nothing spent' guarantee survives its retirement.

handler.note: +1 to all defenses while within Attunement Range (White) of each other (auto). Each of you may take the Aid action targeting the other at any range within Attunement Range (execute by hand). It ends if either deliberately attacks the other.

He spoke the rule once. The world wrote it down.

Spend 1 Investiture and place an Edict on a character in Attunement Range, declaring one prohibited action (move from its space, attack a chosen ally, activate Investiture, etc.). The first time the bound character takes the prohibited action, it takes [Tier][Die] + Intellect spirit damage and is Disoriented until the start of your next turn; the Edict is then consumed. You may sustain up to your tier Edicts; unviolated Edicts fade at the end of the scene.

EdictPlace000000.description: Order (Tessavain). 2bV: the takeover is gone — this ONE place rule is the whole use. `prohibition` runs the engine's picker (move / attack a chosen ally / activate Investiture / free text) and the choice rides the ENTRY; the violation watchers, the Violated button and the resolver key on the ledger, never on this talent's name. allowDuplicates: repeat casts on the SAME target are legal (different prohibitions, each its own entry — Ben R1). multiOwner: the `edict` icon is shared between Order PCs. sceneScoped false: the law follows the creature. Cancelling the picker refunds the cost (the Trade-Routes convention).

handler.note: First violation: [Tier][Die blue]+Int spirit + Disoriented until the start of your next turn; the Edict is then consumed. Unviolated Edicts fade at scene end.

FinalDecreeRule0.description: Order (Tessavain). 2bV — ENGINE-OWNED flow, keyed on THIS rule (no name in code): the prohibition picker, the frozen Witness snapshot, the violation watchers and the batch resolution are a cross-actor multi-step subsystem; this rule carries every dial and the flow reads this talent's damage formula for the court roll. Once/scene + a live enemy net are vetoed BEFORE cost; a picker-cancel refunds. Resolution: every active Edict triggers individually (Ben R9.1), ONE shared Witness THP roll + advantage, ONE shared court roll to each enemy near the violator — violator included (the Magnum-Opus R7a precedent).

LawkeeperAdv0000.description: Order (Tessavain). 2bV: the advantage clause as a config rule — any attack/item test you or an ally rolls against a creature bound on YOUR edicts ledger (or by your active Decree) gains advantage while YOU can see it (hidden/wall LOS auto; darkness GM-judged). placeNote carries the GM-reveal line onto Edict's place card. 'Learn the intended action' itself stays manual — an NPC's intent is not data anywhere in Foundry (Ben-approved 2026-07-03c).

OathIntercept000.description: Order (Tessavain). 2bV: re-litigated from its 07-24u ENGINE_OWNED exit — the 2bU redirect payload DID exist, inverted. A covenanted ally LOST HP with you in White range → whispered Reaction card (once/round): you take floor(D/2) as the SAME type (marked redirected — Devoted-Conduit honest), the ally heals back min(D, floor(D/2) + your White rank), BOTH gain White-rank Temp HP (keeps-higher). Damage fully eaten by Temp HP prompts nothing; D = HP actually lost.
